estimates: The land parcel, front building width and orientation derive from native mapping. The original cottage roof overlaps a long mapped outline. The residential and rear service bounds interpreted from the heritage text, cladding colors and exact dimensions are approximate.
The model includes the main cottage, attached verandahs, adjacent carport and rear block room. The separate guest garage, precinct buildings and demolished writer’s shed are outside this structure.

review.notes: The only public-domain Qualla candidate is a portrait of Xavier Herbert. The exterior Qualla photograph requires attribution. The State heritage inventory and its official parcel establish the living cottage, layout and original roof type.
